summary: Camarines Sur 4th District representative with 76 principal-authored bills. Authored climate-adaptive occupational safety standards, a National Land Transportation Authority and distributed energy resources. Co-authored the national minimum wage and a solidarity contribution on the affluent to fund health.
caveat: Distributional evidence is co-authored only. Election Day holiday bill is a single issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored mandatory climate-adaptive occupational safety standards (-2) and co-authored the national minimum wage (-2) and a solidarity contribution on affluent households for health (-3). Two issues.
